name: @ar/dev-tools
description: Development-only floating control, its surfaces and the feature contract features plug into, plus the Vite dev-server plugin that answers status and stores reports. Self-contained by design: no workspace dependency and no design system.
author: Marcos Tomatti <marcostomatti.cv@gmail.com>

scripts.postbuild: for devtoolsBundle in ./dist/index.js ./dist/feedback.js; do test -f "$devtoolsBundle" || { echo "ERROR: $devtoolsBundle is absent, so the leak grep read nothing" >&2; exit 1; }; done; for devtoolsBundle in ./dist/*.js; do case "$devtoolsBundle" in ./dist/vite.js) continue ;; esac; grep -qE "(from|import|require)[[:space:]]*\(?[[:space:]]*['\"](node:|child_process|yaml['\"/])" "$devtoolsBundle" && { echo "ERROR: a node-only import (node:, child_process or yaml) is imported by the browser entry bundle $devtoolsBundle" >&2; exit 1; }; done; exit 0
